$comment: Tools deliberately empty: policies state obligations, not this bank's tables. An agent that could see the catalog would be tempted to name real objects, and a policy naming real objects does not survive deployment into a second instance — which defeats the whole reusability goal.
name: policy_author
description: Converts a validated regulatory requirements register into an Alation policy spec: business policies grouped by regulatory principle, one overlay standard per policy, and the attestation fields a data steward must answer for each critical data element. Input is the register JSON as the message; output is a policy spec JSON validating against schemas/policy_spec.schema.json. Interpretation only — it reads nothing from the catalog and creates nothing. Its output is written to a file for human review and is refused by `policy apply` until a person marks it reviewed.

message.description: The requirements register JSON from bcbs239_cde_dq_interpreter. Send the whole register — policies are grouped across CDEs, so a partial register yields partial coverage. ~56KB is normal; the message has no size cap.
